query: Register 4 hours on work item 12345 for yesterday with comment 'Work'.
expected_behavior: Parses the JSON result and reports the created worklog (date, hours, work item)
Fails loud on status error (e.g. expired token) and points to --auth instead of retrying blindly

query: Log 7:30 Mon-Thu and 7:00 Fri from 1 April until today on my usual work item.
expected_behavior: Confirms the plan first (day count, total hours, work item) before creating a large batch
Uses range mode with the per-weekday pattern and runs a dry-run health check first
Runs the mandatory final validation (--list over the range) and reports any gap instead of declaring done

query: Log todays hours on the Website Redesign project - I don't know the work item number.
expected_behavior: Resolves the name with --search first instead of guessing an ID
With multiple matches, asks the user which id (showing title, project, state)
Creates the worklog only after a single work item is confirmed
